prompt: What is the general solution of $\tan\theta = 1$?
hint: A general solution adds one full PERIOD of the function each time.

hints.text: A general solution adds one full PERIOD of the function each time.
The period of tangent is $180^\circ$, not $360^\circ$.
So the answers are $45^\circ$, $225^\circ$, $405^\circ$, ... that is, $45^\circ + 180^\circ k$.

explanation: Tangent repeats every $180^\circ$, so every angle $180^\circ$ away from a solution is also a solution.
The general solution is $\theta = 45^\circ + 180^\circ k$ for any integer $k$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Spot-check the runner-up
steps: Choice B would miss $225^\circ$. But $\tan 225^\circ = 1$ too, because that ray has the same slope as the $45^\circ$ ray.
Since $225^\circ$ really is a solution, the step must be $180^\circ$, not $360^\circ$.
